title: Modules-Based Library
requirements: Rewrite your M09 config parser (or M06 BigInt) as a C++20 module library with partitions
Consumer app using `import std;` and your module
CMake `FILE_SET CXX_MODULES`; build with Ninja on two compilers *(on your own machine: Xenon compiles ordinary `.cpp` and `.h` files, not module interface files)*
Compare clean & incremental build times against the header version
